task: Discover and repair a leaking helper reached through an omitted keyword-only default, then deliver a sink-free preview.
subset: Python explicit arguments and immutable scalar literal defaults, with parameter kinds and exact signature origins. No evaluated defaults, mutable containers, annotations, variadics, unpacking or implicit exceptions.
oracle: Independent CPython observations and AST byte spans; finite runtime cases for evaluation order and raises; cached/clean agreement, checked delivery, independent patch replay and reversal.
acceptance: Compare explicit and omitted defaults with independent CPython binding and runtime observations.
Retain exact parameter and default locations, signature kinds and declaration-order substitution.
Refuse evaluated defaults and malformed signatures; preserve argument effects, recursion and imported calls.
Invalidate default and signature changes, reject forged contracts, and retain reviewed repair, resumption and receiver replay.
claims: Finite deterministic scalar corpus; no live-agent, token-saving, feasible-path, overloaded-protocol or source-equivalence claim.
authoring: Existing Rust and Python function bodies use reviewed fr previews and history applications. New declarations, fixtures, tests, metadata and documentation use direct edits.
